source.method: Onkelos-supported lexical anchors as starting point; every verse reviewed word by word (reviewed.json)

1:1.note: Suph rendered "end"; Laban read Lebanon; Di-zahab read Rezahab.

1:2.note: S adds "journey"; Kadesh-barnea rendered Reqam de-Gaya; derekh untranslated.

1:3.note: S adds "thing"; otho expressed by suffix.

1:4.note: Bashan rendered Matnin; S adds "and" before Edrei.

1:7.note: Ba'aravah ("in the Arabah") rendered as name; word-for-word.

1:10.note: Word order: lārov moved before "like the stars".

1:12.note: S adds "then can I"; torah read as "your honour/weight".

1:16.note: S adds "to them" and periphrastic "be hearing".

1:17.note: Idiom "take faces" for hakkir panim; mostly word-for-word.

1:19.note: Derekh rendered "land"; Kadesh-barnea rendered Reqam de-Gaya.

1:24.note: Vayyavo'u rendered "went up"; Eshcol translated; S adds "the land".

1:29.note: Verbs swapped: lo ta'artsun rendered "fear", lo tir'un rendered "tremble".

1:41.note: S adds "our God"; vattahinu rendered "you provoked".

2:7.note: Lekhtekha rendered "your leading"; plural address; "great" untranslated.

2:22.note: "As he did for" rendered "as the sons of Esau did".

2:31.note: Lefanekha rendered "into your hand"; resh rendered "destroy".

3:4.note: "There was not a city" rendered "we did not leave a city".

3:5.note: Levad rendered "besides"; harbeh meod rendered "very many".

3:11.note: Rephaim rendered "giants"; "cubit of a man" rendered "cubit of the giants".

3:12.note: S adds "bank"; Reubenite/Gadite rendered by tribe names.

3:17.note: Ashdot read as place name Ashdod; S adds "in the height".

3:19.note: S adds "leave (them)"; ki rendered by gēr (for).

3:24.note: S adds "and your exalted arm"; question rephrased.

4:1.note: S adds "today"; le-ma'an rendered relative "that you may live".

4:3.note: "Your God" plural; Baal-peor rendered "lord of Peor".

4:7.note: Word-for-word paraphrase of "who has gods near".

4:22.note: Enclitic pronouns linked to pronoun/verb they express (ܠܐ…ܐܢܐ = אינני); ܕܝܢ for ו; plus 'this' after Jordan.

4:25.note: "And sons of sons" rendered "or sons of sons"; noshantem rendered "grow old".

4:42.note: Bivli da'at rendered "not by his will".

4:43.note: S adds "one of them" / "another"; Ramoth-gilead as name.

5:1.note: "Speak in your ears" rendered "say before you"; object pronouns added.

5:11.note: Tissa et shem rendered "swear by the name"; shav rendered "falsehood".

5:15.note: S adds "exalted" arm; la'asot rendered "to keep".

5:17.note: MT verse = four Peshitta verses; shav rendered "false".

5:18.note: S adds 'his vineyard' and repeated 'nor'; tit'avveh rendered 'covet'; ܡܕܡ ܕܐܝܬ = אשר.

5:19.note: Lo yasaf rendered "which has no end".

6:2.note: S lists commandments, laws (and judgments) for MT statutes and commandments; le-ma'an untranslated.

6:3.note: S adds "to give you"; zavat rendered "flowing".

6:7.note: Shinnantam rendered "repeat"; infinitives rendered as clauses with "when".

6:17.note: Infinitive absolute rendered with "but"; plural address.

6:18.note: Order "good and right" reversed; S adds "your God".

6:20.note: Lemor rendered "and he says to you"; testimonies singular; S adds "laws".

7:1.note: Syr 'and when'; 'and they perish' for ונשל.

7:2.note: Object suffixes rendered by separate pronouns.

7:7.note: Paraphrase 'not because you are many'; plus ܗܘܐ.

7:9.note: Ketiv/qere מצותו/מצותיו both mapped to one word.

7:10.note: 'In their lifetime' paraphrases אל פניו; plus repeated 'he repays them'.

7:11.note: Imperative plural; 'to you' from suffix of מצוך.

7:12.note: 'If' for והיה עקב; extra object pronoun after 'keep'.

7:13.note: 'herds of your oxen and flocks of your sheep'.

7:14.note: Plus 'and not even' before 'among your cattle'.

7:23.note: 'strike them a great blow' for והמם מהומה.

7:25.note: 'be defiled' for תוקש; 'despised before the LORD' for abomination.

8:2.note: 'Behold' for זה; interrogative ה rendered by 'if'.

8:4.note: 'were not bare' for בצקה; 'behold' for זה.

8:11.note: 'but keep' for לבלתי שמר; 'go astray' for 'forget'.

8:19.note: Inf. abs. not rendered; 'go astray' for 'forget'.

9:1.note: 'to destroy' for לרשת; plus 'strong' for cities.

9:2.note: Rhetorical question turned into statement 'no man can stand'.

9:5.note: MT יהוה (24) after נשבע not rendered.

9:7.note: ארץ (15) not rendered separately; 'go astray' for 'forget'.

9:21.note: Restructured: 'the calf of your sins which you made'.

9:22.note: Place names translated (Burning, Trials, Graves of lust).

9:23.note: Kadesh-Barnea = Reqem Gaya; MT אלהיכם (18) not rendered.

10:5.note: 'and I left them there' for ויהיו שם.

10:14.note: הן not rendered; copula pronoun plus.

10:18.note: גר rendered 'him who turns to him' (proselyte).

10:19.note: גר again 'those who turn to him'.

11:6.note: 'their sons' for בתיהם; היקום paraphrased 'everything they had that stood on their feet'.

11:10.note: 'garden that is watered' for גן הירק.

11:19.note: Infinitives rendered as 'when you sit' etc.; plural.

11:30.note: Plus 'house' (Beth) before oaks of Mamre for מורה.

12:2.note: Inf. abs. merged; 'shady tree' for עץ רענן.

12:5.note: לשכנו תדרשו paraphrased 'to his dwelling-house you shall go seeking'.

12:13.note: 'that you wish' for אשר תראה; לך (2) not rendered.

12:31.note: Plus 'but you'; second כי not rendered.

13:3.note: 'and says to you: come, let us go'.

13:6.note: 'spoke iniquity before the LORD' for דבר סרה על.

13:7.note: 'wife of your covenant' (ܩܝܡܟ) for חיקך; 'come' plus.

13:15.note: 'if truly the thing is' for והנה אמת נכון.

13:16.note: Inf. abs. + verb as one imperative; doubled 'destroy it'.

13:17.note: 'entirely before the LORD' for כליל ליהוה.

13:18.note: Plus doublet 'and have mercy on you'.

14:5.note: Animal identifications mapped in order; uncertain.

14:12.note: Only eagle listed; פרס, עזניה (7-8) not rendered.

14:13.note: Single bird 'kite'; ראה/איה not rendered separately.

14:16.note: Owl names; identification uncertain, mapped in order; תנשמת not rendered.

14:17.note: Bird names mapped in order; שלך not rendered.

14:25.note: 'sell it' for ונתתה; בו (13) not rendered.

14:29.note: גר as 'him who turns to me'.

15:2.note: 'every man, lord of a debt which his fellow owes him' paraphrase.

15:3.note: 'what you have with your brother, release'.

15:6.note: כי not rendered; 'will bless you' for ברכך.

15:9.note: 'year of release, year of sevens' order inverted.

15:11.note: 'I command you and say to you'.

15:14.note: Plus 'and from your oxen'; 'separate and give' for the inf.abs. pair; ܡܕܡ ܕ = אשר, 'gave you' for ברכך.

15:16.note: 'it is useful to me with you'.

16:5.note: 'you have no authority' for לא תוכל.

16:15.note: 'make a feast' for תחג; אך (20) not rendered.

17:1.note: 'or a lamb'; 'unclean before the LORD' for abomination.

17:4.note: 'if the word is true' for והנה אמת נכון הדבר.

17:6.note: 'he who is guilty of death' for המת; plus repeated 'by the mouth'.

17:10.note: 'as the LORD said' for אשר יבחר.

18:1.note: 'priests and Levites'; כל שבט לוי (5-7) not rendered.

18:6.note: 'your brothers' for שעריך; שם (11) not rendered.

18:8.note: 'apart from the time of the fathers' paraphrase.

19:4.note: Plus 'who killed his fellow'; אשר ינוס שמה (4-6) not rendered; 'not by his will' for בבלי דעת.

19:7.note: 'I command you and say to you'.

19:14.note: Plus 'from of old'; רעך (4) not rendered.

19:18.note: 'and see if he sought to give false testimony'.

20:4.note: Plus 'who brought you up from the land of Egypt'.

20:19.note: Negation לא (21) not rendered; question האדם read as 'is not like a man'.

21:7.note: Word-for-word; ketiv/qere שפכה/שפכו both rendered by one verb.

21:8.note: 'do not reckon' for 'do not give'; ל- rendered ܥܠ.

21:14.note: והיה unexpressed; plus ܐܢܬ; 'trade with her' for תתעמר.

21:16.note: Paraphrase 'he has no authority to make firstborn'; minus הבכר.

21:17.note: 'it is due to him to take two portions'; 'first of his offspring' for ראשית אנו.

21:22.note: Order 'hanged on wood and killed'; plus ܚܠܦ.

22:1.note: Plus ܟܕ and ܐܠܐ; את unlinked.

22:3.note: Plus 'his ox'; second וכן תעשה minus; 'you have no authority to turn away'.

22:5.note: 'unclean before the LORD' for 'abomination of the LORD'.

22:8.note: Restructured: 'lest a man fall from it and there be blood in your house'.

22:14.note: 'trump up pretexts against her'; 'lay with her' for ואקרב.

22:15.note: Ketiv/qere נער/נערה both linked; proleptic ܐܢܘܢ.

22:17.note: הוא unexpressed; 'pretexts' paraphrase as in v.14.

22:25.note: Plus ܒܩܛܝܪܐ 'by force'; second האיש minus.

22:26.note: Plus 'because ... is not guilty'; resumptive ܠܗ.

23:2.note: Peshitta has 'an adulterer' instead of the eunuch description (פצוע דכא וכרות שפכה); left unlinked.

23:3.note: 'son of adultery' for ממזר; לו minus.

23:5.note: 'did not approach you with bread'; Pethor of Aram-naharaim.

23:6.note: 'turned them, his curses, into blessings'; לך minus.

23:8.note: 'do not drive away' for 'do not abhor'.

23:11.note: 'nocturnal crying' for מקרה; plus ethical dative ܠܗ.

23:13.note: Plus ܝܕܝܥ 'known place'; euphemism 'for the water of your feet' for חוץ.

23:14.note: Euphemism 'for the water of your feet' for חוץ.

23:19.note: 'unclean before the LORD' for 'abomination of the LORD'.

23:21.note: 'everything you stretch out your hand to'.

23:23.note: 'if you are not willing to vow' for 'if you refrain'.

24:1.note: 'lies with her' for ובעלה; 'find mercy before him'; מביתו minus.

24:4.note: 'has no authority'; 'it is unclean before the LORD' for תועבה; לו לאשה minus.

24:5.note: עליו and נקי minus; 'go for any matter'.

24:6.note: 'take as pledge'; 'you are distressing a soul' for 'he is taking a life in pledge'.

24:7.note: 'from the sons of Israel' doubled; ketiv sense 'trade with him'.

24:10.note: 'if your companion owes you a debt of anything'.

24:11.note: 'the man who is indebted to you'; 'street' for חוץ.

24:14.note: 'wage of the poor' for 'hired man'; בארצך minus.

24:15.note: 'on his wages he stakes his life'.

24:17.note: 'take as pledge the cloak of the widow'.

25:1.note: 'between a man and his companion'; 'judges' for המשפט.

25:2.note: 'if the guilty one is liable to chastisement'.

25:5.note: יבא עליה and החוצה minus; 'and she shall be his wife'.

25:6.note: 'shall be named after the name of his dead brother'.

25:8.note: 'I will not take her'; חפצתי reduced; plus ܘܐܢ.

25:11.note: 'one with another' for יחדו; 'the one who strikes him'.

25:16.note: 'unclean before the LORD' for תועבת יהוה.

25:18.note: Plus 'with the sword'; 'killed among you all who lagged behind'.

26:5.note: 'My father was led to Aram' for ארמי אבד אבי; 'a short time' for 'few men'; ורב minus.

26:12.note: Plus 'which is the year of tithes'.

26:14.note: 'in my mourning' (אבל) for באוני; 'put for the dead'.

27:6.note: 'before the LORD' for ליהוה; plus ܐܠܐ.

27:14.note: 'all the people of Israel' for כל איש ישראל; הלוים minus.

27:15.note: 'unclean before the LORD' for תועבת יהוה.

28:4.note: 'herds of your oxen and flocks of your sheep'.

28:8.note: אתך minus; 'everything you stretch out your hand to'.

28:12.note: Plus 'you shall rule over many peoples and they shall not rule over you' (cf. 15:6).

28:14.note: 'gods of the peoples' for אלהים אחרים; added negations.

28:18.note: 'herds of your oxen and flocks of your sheep'.

28:22.note: Disease list partly reordered; jaundice for ירקון, scorching wind for שדפון.

28:29.note: 'go up to the head' for תצליח; אך minus.

28:30.note: 'buy' for תארש; 'tread from it' for תחללנו.

28:51.note: Repeated negations are plus; object suffix of final ܕܢܘܒܕܟ renders אתך.

28:66.note: 'by day and by night' order reversed; לך minus.

28:67.note: 'when will it be evening?' for 'who will give evening?'.

29:2.note: Second הגדלים minus; plus 'which you saw'.

29:6.note: 'Matnin' for Bashan; 'laid them waste' for ונכם.

29:8.note: 'commandments of this law' for 'words of this covenant'; 'succeed' as 'go up to the head'.

29:11.note: Read as 'that you do not transgress his covenant'; plus negation.

29:18.note: 'in the desire of my heart'; 'add satiety to thirst'.

29:19.note: 'it will come upon him' for ורבצה בו.

29:22.note: 'but it shall be like Sodom...'; ketiv/qere צביים both linked.

29:28.note: Plus 'to keep and do'; dotted לנו ולבנינו rendered.

30:1.note: 'consider in your heart' for והשבת אל לבבך.

30:4.note: Plus 'Israel ... far off'; 'bring you near' for יקחך.

30:13.note: Plus ܗܘܐ; לים rendered 'crossing of the sea'.

31:12.note: Children as ܝܩܪܬܐ; second למען minus.

31:21.note: 'they will not be forgotten'; plus 'to their fathers'.

31:28.note: 'heads of your tribes' for 'elders of your tribes'.

32:4.note: 'without blemish' for תמים; הצור not rendered.

32:10.note: 'embraced him and loved him' for יסבבנהו יבוננהו.

32:13.note: Ketiv/qere במותי both linked; 'stone' for סלע.

32:14.note: 'Bashan' not clearly rendered; kidneys as ܫܘܡܢܐ.

32:18.note: 'you went astray' for תשי; 'who glorified you' for מחללך.

32:24.note: Free, cf. Onkelos: 'evil spirits' = קטב מרירי, 'to birds I deliver them' = לחמי רשף (רשף as bird); order inverted, pronouns unlinked.

32:25.note: Second גם minus; plus ܘ before suckling.

32:39.note: Participle + enclitic ܐܢܐ for finite verbs; enclitics linked to the explicit Hebrew pronoun where present, else to the verb.

32:43.note: 'atone for his land and for his people'.

32:52.note: Reordered: 'the land which I give to the sons of Israel'; כי minus.

33:2.note: 'to us' for למו; ואתה read 'and with him'; אש דת למו minus.

33:3.note: Plus 'he gave them'; בידך read as 'blessed'.

33:11.note: 'break the loins of his haters and his enemies'.

33:13.note: 'produce from the dew of heaven above'.

33:16.note: 'crown of his brothers' for נזיר אחיו.

34:5.note: 'by the word of the mouth of the LORD'.

34:7.note: 'eye not heavy, cheeks not wrinkled' for 'vigour not fled'.
